page_title: EMP 1-2 GEN | Empoli v Genoa 28/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Genoa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+4' Vitinha (Genoa) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempts to find Caleb Ekuban with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
88' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
88' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is cleared to safety by the defence.

87' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. Empoli win a corner kick.

86' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Nicola Leali pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
83' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Nicola Leali is alert to thwart the effort.
82' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Koni De Winter (Genoa) replaces Morten Thorsby.
81' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Marianucci (Empoli) comes onto the pitch for Liberato Cacace.
80' Here is a change. Faustino Anjorin is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
79' Vitinha (Genoa) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
79' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Antonio Rapuano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
76' Vitinha (Genoa) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.

74' 1 - 2 Faustino Anjorin displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the top right corner – 1:2.
73' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) unleashes a first-time long-range shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to keep it out.
71' Substitution. Alberto Grassi did his best and is replaced by Youssef Maleh (Empoli).
71' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Saba Goglichidze will be replaced by Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli).
70' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Antonio Rapuano blows for a foul. Empoli have a free kick.
68' 0 - 2 Goal! Fabio Miretti feeds Caleb Ekuban (Genoa), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:2.
67' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) plays a lovely through ball to Liberato Cacace, but he can't beat Nicola Leali and loses the ball.
67' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
66' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Antonio Rapuano had an easy-decision to make.
65' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
64' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
63' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) unleashes a close-range volley towards the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
63' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Zanoli goes off and Fabio Miretti (Genoa) comes on.
63' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andrea Pinamonti.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Milan Badelj trots off the pitch and is replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
60' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) replacing Liam Henderson.
58' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
57' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

57' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Empoli have been awarded a corner kick.

54' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) fails to score from the penalty. He aimed his shot towards the left side of the goal, but it was too weak to go past Nicola Leali who made a reflex save and deflected the ball onto the post.
53' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is going to take the penalty!
53' The Empoli players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
52' There's a break in play and referee Antonio Rapuano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Empoli using VAR. This could be interesting!
52' Referee Antonio Rapuano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Roberto D'Aversa, then shows him a yellow.
51' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
51' Dangerous play by Liberato Cacace (Empoli). Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa get a free kick.
49' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
46' 0 - 1 Goal! Milan Badelj (Genoa) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) offside.
45+2' Vitinha (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+1' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) sends a long ball in, but Nicola Leali comfortably gathers the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.

43' A great job from two opposing players there. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) fired a shot nicely in on goal from distance towards the left side of the target, while Nicola Leali produced a wonderful piece of goalkeeping to parry the ball onto the post. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Empoli.
42' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
40' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Aaron Martin (Genoa).

40' Vitinha (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
39' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefano Sabelli is coming onto the pitch as Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
38' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
32' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Nicola Leali easily deals with the threat.
31' The corner kick is deflected to Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
31' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
31' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
29' The referee blows his whistle as Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. Free kick. Genoa will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
28' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' A player from Genoa pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Empoli in a dangerous position.
25' Liam Henderson (Empoli) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post.
22' 0:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. 0:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
17' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Vitinha (Genoa) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
16' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli). It's a free kick to Genoa, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
13' Liam Henderson (Empoli) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
13' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' What a miskick by Vitinha (Genoa). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) sends a long cross over to Vitinha, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes forward to gather the ball.

8' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to deny the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
8' One of the Empoli players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
6' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
5' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
2' It looked like the long-range shot by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
1' The first half has just begun.
Empoli will kick the game off.
Antonio Rapuano is the one to supervise the game today.
